answer_1.quote: Controllable text generation is a challenging task in natural language generation, which aims to generate fluent text with desired attributes.
datasets: Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification Challenge Dataset
answer_1.outputs: generated text with desired attributes (e.g., sentiment, topic, detoxification)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the relevance of each attribute independently and calculate their average as the final relevance metric. Besides, we assess the text quality with perplexity and distinctness concerning fluency and diversity.

answer_4.quote: Moreover, we conduct human evaluation with sentences generated by different models shuffled. Each sentence is rated by three professional evaluators for 3 attribute relevance and text fluency. Evaluators rate each item on a scale of 1 to 5, with 5 representing text highly related to the desired attribute or very fluent.
